init.title: Daily supply charge
init.description: A fixed amount billed per day, regardless of usage. Tariff windows are managed on the integration page.

user.title: Add import window
user.description: A recurring daily period when you pay this import rate. Start is inclusive, end is exclusive. If the end is earlier than the start, the window spans midnight.

reconfigure.title: Edit import window
reconfigure.description: A recurring daily period when you pay this import rate. Start is inclusive, end is exclusive. If the end is earlier than the start, the window spans midnight.

error.zero_length_window: The start and end times must be different.
